A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research work. Their complete main texts, Appendices A–F, equations, tables and figures are readable and support comparison, including v3's additional material.

before.justification: Section 5 and Appendix F report original classifier experiments on MAX-M, Smallest Parent, SUM-M and HWF-M, including accuracy results and variability across runs.

after.justification: V3 retains these original experiments and additionally reports class-specific accuracy comparisons in Figure 8.

M1.justification: Algorithms 1–2, the LP objective and constraints in Equation (6), and CAROT's objective in Equation (7) remain unchanged. Expanded Boolean-encoding explanations and Example D.1 elaborate the existing procedure; the integer pseudo-label option already appears in v2.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same MNIST, CIFAR-10 and handwritten-expression tasks, including the appendix SUM-M and HWF-M scenarios. Figure 8 revisits existing MAX-5 and Smallest Parent settings with imbalance ratio 50.

E2.justification: The corresponding experiments retain SL/Scallop, LA and RECORDS, together with the same proposed-method variants. The added discussion of DeepProbLog and other engines does not introduce an evaluated comparator.

E3.justification: Reported sample sizes, data generation and splits, classifiers, validation use and approximation choices are unchanged. Figure 8 adds class-wise accuracy reporting without specifying a changed training or testing protocol.

E4.justification: New Figure 8 examines how class-specific accuracy under SL and ILP(ALG1) relates to label frequency in two retained imbalanced settings. The existing marginal-estimation, CAROT sensitivity and supplementary robustness analyses remain.

E5.justification: The main experiments retain means and standard deviations over three runs, and the SUM-M/HWF-M tables retain six-run reporting. No new seed information, confidence intervals or statistical tests are introduced.

E6.justification: Tables 1–6 and the existing plotted results are unchanged. Figure 8 adds per-class accuracy curves, showing improvements for several infrequent classes while some MAX-5 classes remain near zero accuracy; the accompanying label-ratio information was already represented in earlier plots.

T1.justification: The main propositions, consistency result and proofs are retained. However, Section 4.1 replaces v2's explicit forward definition of Ψσ from r to p with an inconsistent solution-mapping description, repeated in Table 8. The newly displayed Pσ equation also omits the product of label ratios present in the preceding formula.

C1.justification: The abstract and conclusions retain the same contributions: class-specific risk bounds, the role of the transition function in imbalance, marginal estimation, and training- and testing-time mitigation. The headline improvement claim of up to 14% is unchanged.

C2.justification: Appendix F adds a substantive justification for restricting experiments to Scallop, arguing that competing engines face pre-image computation bottlenecks, timeouts or poorer accuracy, based on cited studies. Existing qualifications concerning non-i.i.d. data, marginal-estimation errors and CAROT failures remain.

D1.justification: Appendix F newly explains the retained SL baseline's Boolean-formula encoding and weighted-model-counting computation. Hardware, software packages, classifier choices, data-processing instructions and top-1 approximation disclosures are otherwise unchanged.

R1.justification: V3 adds the Manhaeve et al. (2021a) DeepProbLog journal reference and expands discussion of neurosymbolic engines and Scallop's scalability. It also more explicitly attributes DNF encoding to existing literature; the principal novelty comparisons remain unchanged.

P1.justification: The technical exposition is substantially reworked across the preliminaries, method descriptions and Appendix D. V3 standardizes class and index notation, expands probability and Boolean-encoding explanations, and reorganizes the LP derivation into explicit steps with a worked example, while retaining the main section order.

P2.justification: V3 adds the four-panel Figure 8 and notation Tables 7–8. Existing figures and tables retain their designs, with local relocations of figures and surrounding text reflow rather than a broad visual redesign.

improvement.justification: Figure 8 adds relevant class-level mitigation evidence absent from v2, while the worked example and notation tables make the technical exposition more explicit. However, the revised Ψσ definition and incomplete Pσ expression introduce inconsistencies into that exposition. With the algorithms and aggregate results unchanged, these explanatory and evidential benefits coexist with mathematical clarity regressions, leaving the net quality direction uncertain.
